block.title: DUNE WORM and DUST DEVIL, encounter concept
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, subtle CRT scanline glow, ultra-wide panoramic arcade framing. A three-lane ambush across a twin-sunned desert: on the left the sand boils as a DUNE WORM, a long brass ring-plated boring machine with a spiral drill-maw, breaches in a curtain of golden grit; in the middle a chain of DUST DEVILS marches toward the viewer, hollow twisting funnels of rust vapor with dark cores and orbiting pebbles, each wobbling its own shear band; on the right the MANTA fighter, flat ray-wings of pale mint and green canopy lit from behind by the big cream sun, slides under the first devil trailing amber thruster ribbons and a fan of green shots. Dune ridges step across the frame in flat silhouette bands from sand-stone light to shadowed umber, heat haze breaking the horizon into shimmering raster lines. Warm sky lifting to deep navy at the top edge, never black, thin stars appearing. Ultra-detailed, large-format, clean vector shapes with pixel-art texture accents.
block.negative: photorealistic, 3d, text, watermark, blurry, pure black, sandcastle, cactus, realistic dust storm
block.notes: The 1536x640 strip turns the three threats into readable lanes — ideal site banner. sd3.5 grades the dune silhouette bands crisply. Watch that devils stay hollow-cored funnels, not solid cones.
